cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The crates went to Leeds. Send the driver to me; I'll sort it quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your email says Leeds. Shall I forward it to the manager?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Forward my corrected address instead. She needs the destination, not the correspondence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants a timeline before approving another van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with when we discovered the error. I'll arrange the van while you write.

mechanism: A uses its pupil report-writing training to omit its own error while directing both the correction and the account of it.
confusable: Not simply fixing a problem: the response deliberately excludes the evidence that A caused it.
comparison: Wrong destination/timeline concealment versus booking log/notice concealment.
seedUse: D61 Leeds/email/timeline; S05 correction of supposedly unprofessional report detail.
